With the accessibility service enabled, Living can read text and controls on the selected app's loaded pages during a reconstruction session you start. It runs the fixed tap, input or scroll steps you trigger.

Pages, account contents and current input stay on this phone and are not sent to AI by default. Use the original app for login, payments and protected pages. Stop the session or turn off the service in system settings at any time.
